STACK · DROP · BALANCE

Build a playful tower of stones. Move each piece into place, let gravity do its thing, and see how long you can keep everything balanced.

01

GRAB & POSITION

Drag a stone with your pointer. Move it around freely and find the right spot in your stack.

02

LET IT DROP

Release to let gravity take over. Every stone reacts to the others — keep the whole stack standing.

03

FIND THE BALANCE

Use A / D or the rotation controls to adjust a stone. Small moves can make a big difference.
